title: Anulom Vilom Ka Jabardast Funda!
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, a glossy cute character with big expressive eyes and a small headband, hyper-detailed macro close-up, cinematic soft lighting, rich colours, vertical 9:16

ANULOM.look: A friendly, plump cartoon cloud with a calm, mischievous smile, wearing a tiny saffron headband, with two stylized nostrils on his 'body'.

DIMAG.look: A cute, slightly wrinkled cartoon brain character with big, worried eyes, a small sweatdrop, and a tiny 'thinking cap' on its head.

scenes.image: [[ANULOM]] in a zen pose, slightly mischievous smile, looking at the viewer.
scenes.speaker: ANULOM
scenes.line: Arre bhidu! Main hoon Anulom Vilom, tera naya jigri yaar!
scenes.say: अरे भिडू! मैं हूँ अनुलोम विलोम, तेरा नया जिगरी यार!

scenes.image: [[ANULOM]] in a zen pose, slightly mischievous smile, looking at the viewer.
scenes.speaker: ANULOM
scenes.line: Apne se milke dekh, ekdum mann shaant ho jayega!
scenes.say: अपने से मिलके देख, एकदम मन शांत हो जाएगा!

scenes.image: [[ANULOM]] in a zen pose, slightly mischievous smile, looking at the viewer.
scenes.speaker: ANULOM
scenes.line: Dheere-dheere saans le, ekdum chain milega.
scenes.say: धीरे-धीरे सांस ले, एकदम चैन मिलेगा।

scenes.image: [[DIMAG]] with a tiny sweatdrop, looking confused and stressed.
scenes.speaker: DIMAG
scenes.line: Arey Anulom Bhai, mera toh dimaag ghum gaya hai, badi pareshani!
scenes.say: अरे अनुलोम भाई, मेरा तो दिमाग घूम गया है, बड़ी परेशानी!

scenes.image: [[DIMAG]] with a tiny sweatdrop, looking confused and stressed.
scenes.speaker: DIMAG
scenes.line: Koi bolta hai ye kar, koi wo, BP high ho raha hai!
scenes.say: कोई बोलता है ये कर, कोई वो, बीपी हाई हो रहा है!

scenes.image: [[DIMAG]] with a tiny sweatdrop, looking confused and stressed.
scenes.speaker: DIMAG
scenes.line: Paanch minute tujhe karu toh kya hoga?
scenes.say: पांच मिनट तुझे करू तो क्या होगा?

scenes.image: [[ANULOM]] still zen, winking at the viewer.
scenes.speaker: ANULOM
scenes.line: Fikr nahi lene ka, bhai! Ek naak band kar, doosri se saans le.
scenes.say: फिक्र नहीं लेने का, भाई! एक नाक बंद कर, दूसरी से सांस ले।

scenes.image: [[ANULOM]] still zen, winking at the viewer.
scenes.speaker: ANULOM
scenes.line: Phir ulta kar, paanch minute bas, simple lafda!
scenes.say: फिर उल्टा कर, पांच मिनट बस, सिंपल लफड़ा!

scenes.image: [[ANULOM]] still zen, winking at the viewer.
scenes.speaker: ANULOM
scenes.line: Dimag ko ekdum shanti milegi, ekdum mast lagega.
scenes.say: दिमाग को एकदम शांति मिलेगी, एकदम मस्त लगेगा।

scenes.image: [[DIMAG]] now slightly less frazzled, a hint of a smile, sweatdrop gone.
scenes.speaker: DIMAG
scenes.line: Acha, aise kya? Yeh toh ekdum aasaan hai, bhidu!
scenes.say: अच्छा, ऐसे क्या? ये तो एकदम आसान है, भिडू!

scenes.image: [[DIMAG]] now slightly less frazzled, a hint of a smile, sweatdrop gone.
scenes.speaker: DIMAG
scenes.line: Thoda-thoda shanti mil rahi hai, haan, sahi pakde hain!
scenes.say: थोड़ा-थोड़ा शांति मिल रही है, हाँ, सही पकड़े हैं!

scenes.image: [[DIMAG]] now slightly less frazzled, a hint of a smile, sweatdrop gone.
scenes.speaker: DIMAG
scenes.line: Ekdum sukoon aa raha hai, kitne der tak karna hai?
scenes.say: एकदम सुकून आ रहा है, कितने देर तक करना है?

scenes.image: [[ANULOM]] looking a bit more serious, but still friendly, explaining something.
scenes.speaker: ANULOM
scenes.line: Bas paanch minute, zyada nahi! Din mein kabhi bhi kar sakte ho.
scenes.say: बस पांच मिनट, ज़्यादा नहीं! दिन में कभी भी कर सकते हो।

scenes.image: [[ANULOM]] looking a bit more serious, but still friendly, explaining something.
scenes.speaker: ANULOM
scenes.line: Yeh bas aaraam ke liye hai, koi dawa nahi hai, samjha?
scenes.say: ये बस आराम के लिए है, कोई दवा नहीं है, समझा?

scenes.image: [[ANULOM]] looking a bit more serious, but still friendly, explaining something.
scenes.speaker: ANULOM
scenes.line: Agar koi health problem hai, toh doctor ko milne ka, pakka?
scenes.say: अगर कोई हेल्थ प्रॉब्लम है, तो डॉक्टर को मिलने का, पक्का?

scenes.image: [[DIMAG]] completely calm, smiling broadly, with a small flower on its head.
scenes.speaker: DIMAG
scenes.line: Arre wah! Ab lag raha hai dimag mein ekdum thandak!
scenes.say: अरे वाह! अब लग रहा है दिमाग में एकदम ठंडक!

scenes.image: [[DIMAG]] completely calm, smiling broadly, with a small flower on its head.
scenes.speaker: DIMAG
scenes.line: Yeh Anulom Vilom toh ekdum jaadu jaisa kaam karta hai!
scenes.say: ये अनुलोम विलोम तो एकदम जादू जैसा काम करता है!

scenes.image: [[DIMAG]] completely calm, smiling broadly, with a small flower on its head.
scenes.speaker: DIMAG
scenes.line: Aap mann ki shaanti ke liye aur kya karte ho, bolo?
scenes.say: आप मन की शांति के लिए और क्या करते हो, बोलो?
